measured_branch_head_run.command: uv run --extra runtime pytest tests src/nebuko/engine/lib -q --tb=short -rf

measured_branch_head_run_clean_env.command: VIRTUAL_ENV= uv run --extra runtime pytest tests src/nebuko/engine/lib -q --tb=no -rf
measured_branch_head_run_clean_env.env: clean CI-style env (no VIRTUAL_ENV, system PATH)

measured_merged_tree_run.command: uv run --extra runtime pytest tests src/nebuko/engine/lib -q --tb=no
measured_merged_tree_run.env: same session machine, tree = branch+main merge (git read-tree of merge-tree commit)

note: The env counterfactual (clean env at same SHA) gives identical counts, ruling out the engine-venv/path hypothesis. The checkout counterfactual (merged tree at same machine) drops failures 37->10 and subtests 6->14, matching CI's shape. CI tests the merge commit GitHub creates for a PR; the workflow's use-session-branch.sh checks out the branch head.
